name: open_uploader
title: Get a recording upload link
description: Use this when the user wants to add a local audio or video recording to BitterClip. Returns a shareable, token-gated upload link (a hosted drop-zone page) the user opens in a browser to drop their file — it uploads straight to storage and starts transcribing on its own. `project` (a project name, slug, or public ID) scopes the upload to that project; without it, uploads land in the account's default uploads project. The returned `upload_url` is the page the user opens, so no public download URL is needed.

project.description: Optional project to attach uploads to: a project name, slug, or public ID; absent means the default uploads project.

capture_session_id.description: Optional footage-session public ID. Every file uploaded through the link joins this same capture chronology.

mode.description: "upload_link" when a shareable upload link is returned.

upload_url.description: The token-gated drop-zone page URL for the user.

project.description: The resolved project the uploads land in, or null for the default project.

capture_session.description: The footage session the uploads join, when requested.
